core_props_diff:
--- template
+++ core-b.fw.properties
@@ -539,7 +539,7 @@
 # structure (\d, ^, $, |, ...) is stripped before the check, so structural
 # patterns stay acceptable -- only literal text that cannot appear among codes
 # is rejected.
-core.replace.patternPolicy=permissive
+core.replace.patternPolicy=warn
 
 # ignore = say nothing when a pattern matches no row (historical behaviour)
 # warn   = log a WARNING naming the patterns that changed nothing
@@ -563,4 +563,4 @@
 # summary = one INFO line per grouped sheet: rows seen / rewritten / dropped,
 #           and how many rows each pattern changed. Changes no outcome; makes
 #           a silent no-op visible.
-core.replace.diagnostics=off
+core.replace.diagnostics=summary
note: demo.xlsx bytes carry zip timestamps; compare cell content with build_spec.py --check
